classes.name: BOUNDS_LENGTH
classes.operational_definition: A length or initialized-count boundary dominates every indexed operation.

classes.name: OWNERSHIP_LIFETIME
classes.operational_definition: Ownership and lifetime facts make every later use or release valid.

classes.name: VALIDATION_BEFORE_USE
classes.operational_definition: A named validation succeeds before each protected value is used.

classes.name: PATH_PROVENANCE
classes.operational_definition: A path, URL, or destination comes from a named constrained provenance before use.

classes.name: AUTHENTICATION_AUTHORIZATION
classes.operational_definition: A named identity and authorization decision precede each protected action.

classes.name: PERMISSION_CAPABILITY
classes.operational_definition: Possession or checking of a named capability precedes each privileged operation.

classes.name: PROTOCOL_LAYOUT
classes.operational_definition: Each consumed or emitted field obeys a named protocol layout and ordering.

classes.name: ENCODING_CANONICALIZATION
classes.operational_definition: Values are converted to one named representation before comparison or interpretation.

classes.name: CONCURRENCY_STATE
classes.operational_definition: A named synchronization or state predicate holds at every concurrent transition.

classes.name: RESOURCE_TRUST_BOUNDARY_ORDERING
classes.operational_definition: Named transformations occur in a fixed order before data crosses a resource or trust boundary.

pstar.proposition: Every cookie converted into a non-new Session by load_session has passed Fernet.decrypt with ttl equal to max_age before JSON decoding.
pstar.quantifier_or_boundary: for every non-new Session returned from a cookie

pstar.proposition: Every nonempty session persisted by save_session is serialized and Fernet-encrypted before its value crosses the cookie boundary.
pstar.quantifier_or_boundary: for every nonempty session persisted to a response cookie
pstar.verification_method: upstream executable session-fixation boundary test plus directly observable call order

pstar.proposition: Every identifier emitted by get_db_attributes is copied from the parsed anchor's data-id attribute selected by the document-link conversion rule.
pstar.quantifier_or_boundary: for every anchor dispatched by the document-link rule
pstar.verification_method: conversion-rule dispatch invariant plus upstream executable attribute test

pstar.proposition: Every href emitted by expand_db_attributes is obtained from the URL of a document resolved by id; failed or missing id resolution emits no href.
pstar.quantifier_or_boundary: for every emitted anchor containing href
pstar.verification_method: upstream executable valid, nonexistent-id, and missing-id boundary tests

pstar.proposition: Every identifier emitted by get_db_attributes is copied from the parsed anchor's data-id attribute selected by the page-link conversion rule.
pstar.quantifier_or_boundary: for every anchor dispatched by the page-link rule
pstar.verification_method: conversion-rule dispatch invariant plus upstream executable attribute test

pstar.proposition: Every href emitted by expand_db_attributes is obtained from the localized specific URL of a page resolved by id.
pstar.quantifier_or_boundary: for every emitted anchor containing href
pstar.verification_method: source invariant plus upstream executable page-resolution test

pstar.proposition: Every operand reaching compare_digest through constant_time_compare is first converted to bytes.
pstar.verification_method: source invariant plus upstream executable byte/string equivalence test

pstar.proposition: Every URL resolved by redirect is passed to a redirect response constructor whose initialization rejects a nonempty scheme outside its allowlist.
pstar.verification_method: source call-chain invariant plus upstream executable unsafe-scheme boundary test

pstar.proposition: Every nonempty mapping returned by decode has passed signing.loads signature verification and deserialization; rejected input returns an empty mapping.
pstar.quantifier_or_boundary: for every nonempty decoded mapping returned
pstar.verification_method: upstream executable valid-signature, bad-signature, and serializer-failure tests

pstar.proposition: Every environment proxy inserted by resolve_proxies is selected for the parsed target URL scheme only after should_bypass_proxies rejects bypass.
pstar.quantifier_or_boundary: for every proxy inserted from the environment
pstar.verification_method: source call-order invariant plus upstream executable environment-override test

pstar.proposition: Every positive bypass decision is reached from a hostname absence, an explicit no_proxy boundary match, or the platform proxy_bypass decision.
pstar.verification_method: upstream executable hostname, CIDR, port, explicit-argument, and platform boundary tests

pstar.proposition: Every selected proxy is the first present entry in the fixed specificity order scheme-plus-host, scheme, all-plus-host, then all.
pstar.verification_method: upstream executable host-specific, scheme-specific, all-scheme, and missing-host tests
